purpose: Bounded source feasibility only; no price queries, return calculation, model fitting, or strategy signal
universe_required_before_backtest: All Taiwan public tender offers first legally filed/commenced in 2024, including failed, withdrawn, amended, extended, cash and noncash cases; earlier announced but not commenced proposals logged separately, never silently excluded as successful-only
cohort_date_basis: Initial legal filing/commencement, not completion year; amendments retain original case identity and timestamps
discovery_already_seen: Web search saw MOPS t162sb02 entry, current TDCC catalog, Yuanta index and selected 2024 PDFs. This is not an untouched out-of-sample strategy protocol.
gate: Authoritative year-filtered complete case index with scope and pagination independently reconciled; no broker-only or search-only substitute
Initial terms, all amendments, final outcomes and original public availability evidence for each case
Minimum/maximum quantity, oversubscription allocation, settlement timing, returned shares, deductions and financing/approval conditions captured without hindsight
Archived originals independently retrieved and SHA/CRC/manifest verified
stop: If the complete 2024 cohort cannot be verified within the bounded probes, stop this route at source_gate_not_passed; do not request manual case downloads, retry indefinitely, estimate profitability, or infer that the economic hypothesis is disproven
next_research_requires: A separately frozen economic hypothesis, participation/capital/cost rules, PIT case ledger and predeclared decision criteria before any prices/returns are inspected
legacy_rules_and_inputs: Unchanged; seven-rule daily prospective plan remains stopped; no new valid prospective signal or order
